summary: Built 1936 by CCC crews on Lassen NF; tower and cab removed 2009 for a planned Davis rebuild that no source read confirms; site condition today is unknown.

facts.design: 20-foot L-401 tower with BC-301 wood frame cab (Register); a 1936 newspaper item describes a thirty-foot steel tower
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Register); the 2009 CEQA notice names CAL FIRE as the public agency
facts.status_note: Tower and cab taken down in 2009; reassembly at CAL FIRE's Davis facility was planned, and no source read confirms it happened

events.note: Register says built in 1936; a 1936 newspaper item says the CCC camp completed it in spring
O.E. Kirkpatrick and his wife occupied the station June 1 to November 1
Weather reports held up in July 1944 while workers searched for a fuel moisture stick a porcupine had carried off
Station closed; the 2009 notice says it had been closed since 1991
Register says the lookout was removed in 2009 and its cab placed in storage
Notice planned dismantling and rebuilding at CAL FIRE's Davis facility, likely 2009-2010; completion not confirmed
Register's 2012 update planned restoration in Davis and public opening, with a January 1, 2015 target
Site and about 40 acres listed among excess state properties under review, possibly for sale

corrections.why: The Register says the lookout was removed in 2009 and its cab put in storage, and the 2009 notice planned a move to Davis. No source read confirms the tower is gone for good, so removed with a status note is more exact.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives a 20-foot L-401 tower. A November 1936 item puts the station's quarters on a thirty-foot steel tower. No height fact is recorded.

The Register lists the U.S. Forest Service as administrator. The 2009 CEQA notice names CAL FIRE as the public agency and says a 40-acre parcel was to go back to Lassen National Forest, which refused it.

sources.title: Digger Butte fire Lookout Station - Tower Relocation/Surplus Property Disposal

notes_for_editor: Built date, 1936 staffing and the 2009 removal are well sourced. Fate after 2012 is not: no source read says whether the tower was rebuilt at Davis, and none describes the site now. The 2014 excess-property entry is from the weebly page and is a listing, not a sale. Two web searches used; no later update found. Brief's agency (U.S. Forest Service) matches the Register; the CEQA notice shows CAL FIRE as the 2009 public agency. Photo leads, not recorded because licenses were not checked: archive.org Knedler 1952 photos of Digger Butte (casbcfm_000226, casbcfm_000228). FFLOS 2018 registration (April 3, 2018) verified on firetower.org but not used in the story.
